name: The Square
ket: H on all four qubits, then CZ around a square: (q0,q1), (q1,q2), (q2,q3), (q3,q0)
brief: A four-qubit cluster state, the kind of entangled resource that measurement-based quantum computing is built on. The obvious way uses four CZs, and CZ isn't in your bag. Every amplitude is +1/4 or -1/4: the sign is (-1) to the power x0x1 + x1x2 + x2x3 + x3x0.
